decisions.reason: Given its misalignment with the firm's core collector base and the declining CD format, four years of results likely show its option value is exhausted, so dropping it frees resources.
The illustrated series builds on the firm's curated physical media strength and appeals to collectors, so its option value remains uncertain but promising and cheap to keep.
The reissued jazz vinyl LP directly fits the firm's core collector audience and the vinyl revival, so its option value is likely still positive and worth maintaining.
The multi-disc box set is a high-value collectible that aligns with the firm's established offer, so despite higher costs, its option value justifies keeping it open while sales remain uncertain.
The compilation CD is close to the firm's existing catalog and cheap to keep, so it remains a low-cost option while its niche appeal is still being assessed.
